pattern: Rust modules by topic; methods that leave an impl stay methods, in a second `impl X` block in the new module, which Rust allows within one crate
note: lib.rs keeps Document, its constructor and its reads (len, get, walk, positions), declares `mod json; mod apply; mod node; mod history;` beside `pub mod edits; pub mod frac;`, and says `pub use node::{Handle, Node, Change, DocError, Applied, Props}; pub use history::{History, Ids};` so the crate's public names stay. apply_one (114 lines) is cut in phase 2 by op (insert, update, replace, delete, move, copy).
